This page consolidates two Operations Research courses — **EEI744 (Operations Research II)** and **EEI946 (Operations Research III)** — that I taught in sequence at UFRJ's Escola Politécnica (Federal University of Rio de Janeiro), as part of the same optimization training track. Since the fundamental content of the two is the same — modeling and solving optimization problems — this page brings them together into a single course.

## Final Objectives

Students should be able to build nonlinear, linear, mixed-integer linear, and dynamic programming optimization models, applying them to inventory, graph, and queueing problems.

## Source Courses

- **EEI744 — Operations Research II**
- **EEI946 — Operations Research III**
